scope: Computer Control Phase 9B3C native file picker explicit accept/cancel with independent AppKit completion observation
platform: macOS Cocoa/AppKit NSOpenPanel via registered Provider and native Accessibility

historicalEvidence.blockedReason: NSOpenPanel did not expose AXDefaultButton/AXCancelButton relationships on the supported picker surface
historicalEvidence.failedReason: native OKButton accept delivery and picker dismissal succeeded, but the generic client.find-based fixture result observer failed to observe the completion label
historicalEvidence.diagnosticResult: PASS; independent read-only AX observer captured Picker Result: accepted Alpha.txt

safetyBoundary.addressing: registered application Provider only; exactly one running Provider process and one supported native picker
safetyBoundary.acceptTarget: one backend-private native AXButton with physically observed identifier OKButton
safetyBoundary.cancelTarget: one backend-private native AXButton with physically observed identifier CancelButton
safetyBoundary.postcondition: after advertised native AXPress, Provider remains running and independent fresh filePicker.observe reports picker null; separate read-only AX observer verifies the AppKit completion result
safetyBoundary.cleanup: physical harness may stop only its temporary test-owned fixture process

expectedCoverage: filePicker.observe, filePicker.selectItem and filePicker.expandDirectory remain PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED
filePicker.accept and filePicker.cancel remain IMPLEMENTED until this session passes
a real AppKit NSOpenPanel opens at PickerRoot
Alpha.txt is selected through already validated native selection semantics before accept
filePicker.accept targets the backend-private physically observed OKButton AXButton and delivers only advertised AXPress
accept succeeds only when picker is independently absent while Provider remains running
independent read-only AX observer records Picker Result: accepted Alpha.txt
picker can be reopened after accept
filePicker.cancel targets the backend-private physically observed CancelButton AXButton and delivers only advertised AXPress
cancel succeeds only when picker is independently absent while Provider remains running
independent read-only AX observer records Picker Result: cancelled
no label matching, coordinate, mouse, keyboard, clipboard, synthetic keypress or filesystem fallback is used
